aries.essence: Love in pursuit — falls fast, signals early. Wants someone brave enough to say no to games; hates drawn-out small talk.

taurus.essence: Love through touch, food, and quiet time together. Slow to trust — but once attached, hard to unattach.

gemini.essence: Attraction starts in conversation. Prizes wit and range; bored fast by anyone slow to keep up.

cancer.essence: Love through caretaking — cooking, remembering details, showing up on hard days. Needs safety before opening fully.

leo.essence: Loves big gestures and being proud of a partner in public. Needs sincere admiration, not polite tolerance.

virgo.essence: Love through detail — bringing medicine, remembering allergies. Rarely says it, always shows it through practical care.

libra.essence: Classic romance — beautiful dinners, deep talks, aesthetic settings. Struggles alone; "we" feels more natural than "I".

scorpio.essence: Intense attraction, deep, a little secretive. Needs partners brave enough to speak hard truths — trust is slow and expensive.

sagittarius.essence: Loves partners who bring a new world — stories, ideas, places. Room to breathe = requirement, not preference.

capricorn.essence: Doesn't play — if interested, thinks about where it's going. Affection through consistency, not grand drama.

aquarius.essence: Attraction often starts from strong friendship. Needs space; hates partners who demand full merge.

pisces.essence: Love in its most poetic form — sees a partner at their best potential. Needs someone who helps hold boundaries, not exploit softness.

aries.essence: Acts before overthinking — first instinct usually right. Angers fast, cools fast.

taurus.essence: Moves slow but hard to stop. Anger needs time to grow — once out, it's usually been stored a while.

gemini.essence: Acts through argument and idea — clever with persuasion. Restless; starts many projects at once.

cancer.essence: Struggles head-on — trends passive-aggressive when upset. Fights for loved ones more than for the self.

leo.essence: Moves with style — wants to be seen doing it. Angered when unappreciated; the ego needs room.

virgo.essence: Acts through tidy plans and exact moves. Anger comes as detailed critique — not shouting.

libra.essence: Avoids open conflict, but has subtle ways of winning. Best acting through collaboration, not solo.

scorpio.essence: Moves quietly, strikes precisely. Anger slow-burning, long-holding; revenge isn't the style but memory is.

sagittarius.essence: Big action with forward vision. Needs a purpose bigger than winning — rarely moves for petty stakes.

capricorn.essence: Slow, consistent, directed action — marathon not sprint. Controlled anger; when it slips, boundaries were already crossed hard.

aquarius.essence: Moves in unconventional ways — quiet rebellion or open one. Cold anger, not explosive.

pisces.essence: Rarely acts straight — often through intuition and evasion. Hard to anger head-on; more likely to retreat or dissolve.
